stem.text: A voltmeter connected between two points P and Q in an electrical circuit shows a reading of $1\,\text{V}$.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram: a wire with a voltmeter V connected between point P, marked +, and point Q, marked −.

A.text: The energy needed to move $+1\,\text{C}$ of charge from P to Q is $1\,\text{J}$.

B.text: The energy needed to move $+1\,\text{C}$ of charge from Q to P is $1\,\text{J}$.

C.text: The energy needed to move one electron from P to Q is $1\,\text{J}$.

D.text: The energy needed to move one electron from Q to P is $1\,\text{J}$.
